arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Settle to about pod critical power (148 W shaft, may be 10-25 pct off) after the hard start. Spend a little more into adverse current or wind, a little less with it. Keep pod reserve above about 30 pct until 2 km to go, then build; final sprint (finish) at about 600-800 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for: speed drop at the same pod power (weed on rudder: clear_rudder), pod power drifting from boat power (pod drift), radio course changes (set_race_distance).

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give, beyond the current estimate: weed on rudder, drag, or pod drift?

arguments.reason: check the paddler has settled after the hard start

text: no cue: hard start is normal, set plan and watches for drag and low pod reserve, rechecking at 2.4 min whether the paddler settled.

arguments.text: 2.4 min: hard start spent about half the pod reserve (54 pct left). Settling: shaft 157 W, rate 65, sustainable shaft 150 W. Leg 1 (heading 0) has adverse push about -0.22 m/s; expect help on the return legs. No cue yet.

text: no cue: paddler is settling toward sustainable power on their own after the hard start; noted reserve spent.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Long smooth strokes, long race ahead.

5.4 min: shaft 163 W vs sustainable 149, pod reserve 34 pct, boat reserve 13 pct. Paddler says 8/10 hurting, not sure can hold. Cued ease (no pace target, turn at 1250 m comes soon). After the turn the current should help: aim about 145-150 W there.

arguments.reason: after the first turn: check the ease took and set downstream effort

text: Cued ease: 15 W over sustainable pod power, reserve draining, paddler says hurting at 8/10.
no cue: ease cue took (pod 163 to 155 W), reserve near 30 pct as expected; moved the reserve watch to 15 pct; wake after the turn is pending.

arguments.message: Pod power more than 12 W above pod critical power for a minute: drifting back up?

text: no cue: past the turn with the current helping, pod power at critical power (149 W), reserve 27 pct steady; added a watch for creeping back above it.

arguments.text: Good work. Ease slightly with the current, breathe, recover here.

8.9 min, leg 2 (downstream, push +0.2 to +0.27): paddler says cooked, cannot hold, at pod 149 W = pod CP, pod reserve 27 pct, no speed fade. Possible pod CP overestimated after the hard start. Cued ease on this helping leg (cheap in time) to recover; plan to put a bit more into the upstream legs (odd legs, heading 0). Boat reserve reads empty but it counts current as paddler; trust pod more.

text: Cued ease with reassurance: paddler says cooked at critical power; easing on the helping leg costs little time and hedges a possibly high critical power.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Odd legs (heading 0) are upstream (push about -0.15 to -0.2), even legs (heading 180) downstream (push about +0.25). Target pod power: about 150-153 W upstream, 142-146 W downstream (pod CP 148 W, may be optimistic: paddler said cooked at 8.9 min and 7/10 really hurting at 12 min). Trust pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) over boat reserve (boat one counts current as paddler and reads empty). Keep pod reserve near 25-30 pct until about 2 km to go, then build; finish cue at about 600-800 m to go if reserve allows. Avoid pace targets that carry across a turn. Watch for drag jump (weed: clear_rudder), pod drift, radio course changes (set_race_distance).

arguments.reason: start of leg 3 (upstream): check effort, maybe ask for a little more into the current

text: no cue: easing took (143-148 W downstream), paddler at 7/10 and recovering, pod reserve 29 pct; updated plan, wake set after the next turn.
no cue: paddler already at 152 W into the current on leg 3, matching the plan; pod reserve 23 pct.

arguments.text: Wind is behind you now. Settle slightly, save it for headwind.

16.5 min: radio says south wind filling in, 8-12 knots. It helps the north legs (odd, heading 0, against current) and hurts the south legs (even, heading 180, with current). push_local on leg 3 rose from -0.21 to -0.09; push_along lags, so speed_water and boat power read high for a while. drag_jump watch may false-fire on leg 4 (push_local below the lagging push_along): check against the wind before calling weed. Pod reserve 19 pct at 153 W; cued ease on this tailwind stretch to save for the headwind legs.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Current: against on odd legs (heading 0), with on even legs (heading 180). From 16.5 min a south wind (8-12 kn) helps odd legs and hurts even legs, so the slower leg over the ground may switch to the even legs: compare push_local and GPS speed by leg (legs()) and put a few watts more (about +4 W) into whichever leg is slower, a few less into the faster one. Average pod power about 148 W (pod CP 148 W, may be optimistic: paddler hurting since 9 min). Trust pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) over boat reserve. Pod reserve 19 pct at 16.5 min: hold it there until about 2 km to go, then build; finish cue at about 600-800 m to go if reserve allows. Avoid pace targets that carry across a turn. Weed: speed drop at same pod power not explained by wind (clear_rudder). Radio course changes: set_race_distance.

text: Cued ease on the new tailwind stretch to save reserve for the coming headwind legs; plan updated for the south wind.
no cue: pod power 150 W near critical, reserve steady at 18 pct; wind now cancels the current on this leg, so even effort is right.

arguments.text: Your numbers say you can hold this. Steady, you are fine.

20.8 min: paddler complains again (4th time since 5 min) but has held 148-152 W pod for 12 min with no collapse; if pod CP were 10 pct lower they would have blown up by now, so pod CP about right. Cued reassure (no change). Pod reserve 16 pct.

text: Cued reassure: paddler doubts themselves but has held critical power for 12 min without fading; no change wanted.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 6 pct with more than 1.5 km to go

arguments.reason: leg 4 (current with, wind against): compare push and set effort

text: no cue: pod reserve 14.5 pct is on track for a constant-power finish at about 149 W; moved the reserve watch lower and will check leg 4 conditions.

arguments.text: Back off a touch into this wind, steady effort, long way left.

22.5 min, leg 4 (south, current with, wind against): push_local about -0.1 (headwind outweighs current). Pod power jumped to 160-162 W after the turn (after my reassure cue) and pod reserve fell from 16 to 5 pct in about a minute. Cued ease. Need average about 148 W from here; little reserve left for a sprint, so the finish push should start late (about 400-600 m).

text: Cued ease: pod power surged to 162 W into the headwind and the pod reserve is down to 5 pct with 6 km left.

arguments.reason: check the ease cue at 22.6 min brought pod power below 148 W; pod reserve about 3 pct, blow-up risk

text: no cue: ease cue just given (next allowed in 30 s); headwind explains the low push, not weed or pod drift; checking its effect in a minute.

arguments.text: Settle to two fifty-one pace and hold it there.

24.1 min: pod reserve reads 0 at 157 W, no collapse yet. Ease at 22.6 min only took pod 163 to 155. Cued ease with GPS pace target 171 s/500 (2.92 m/s): legs 3 and 4 now have similar ground speed (about 2.95 at 150-157 W) so the target suits both sides of the turn, about 145-148 W. If the paddler holds 155+ W for 10 more minutes without fading, pod CP is probably higher than 148 (consider set_critical_power). Pod jump to 160 W came exactly at the turn into the headwind, so likely real effort, not pod drift.

text: Cued ease to a 171 s/500 ground pace: pod reserve reads empty at 157 W, need to get back to about critical power to avoid a blow-up.

arguments.text: 27.1 min: paddler followed the 171 pace target (GPS 2.92-2.94) but pod still reads 153-156 W, and pod reserve has read 0 for 4 min with no collapse. Either pod CP is higher than 148 or the pod reads high (drift). Test on leg 5 (north, same conditions as leg 3 after the wind: 150 W gave 2.97 GPS, push_local about 0): if the pod needs about 160 W for 2.97 there, suspect pod drift (+8-10 W).

arguments.reason: leg 5 about 200 m in: compare pod power at the same GPS speed with leg 3 (pod drift test)

text: no cue: paddler is holding the 171 pace target; pod reserve reads empty without a collapse, so testing for pod drift on the next leg.

arguments.reason: Paddler has averaged about 153 W pod and 101 W boat-model power for 25 min with no speed fade, and the pod reserve has read empty for 6 min with no collapse; the pre-race test underestimated critical power by about 3-4 pct. Reserve sizes kept.

arguments.text: Good. Hold two fifty-one, steady, the sprint comes later.

29.7 min: set pod CP 153 W, boat CP 99 W (evidence: about 153 W pod and 101 W boat average for 25 min, no fade, no collapse at an empty pod reserve). Paddler answers 8/10 hurting every time, so the words carry little information. Pod power creeping up (leg 5: 163 W for 2.94 GPS vs 150 W for 2.97 late on leg 3), rate down 65 to 64: possible pod drift or blade fatigue, so trust GPS pace over pod power. Re-cued hold at 171 s/500; ground speed now similar on both directions, so a pace target is fine across turns.

text: Raised critical power to 153 W pod / 99 W boat on 25 min of evidence (reserves now 44 pct) and cued hold at 171 s/500 to keep power from creeping up.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Since about 20 min the wind and current roughly cancel, so ground speed is similar both ways and a GPS pace target works across turns. Critical power corrected at 29.7 min to 153 W pod / 99 W boat (paddler held that for 25 min); reserves then read 44 pct. Pod power may be drifting high (trust GPS pace more than pod watts). Plan: hold 171 s/500 (about 150-155 W) until 2 km to go; at 2 km go to about 168; at about 700 m to go cue finish (sprint) if pod reserve is above about 20 pct, else at about 400 m. The paddler always says 8/10 hurting: little information. Watch for weed (speed drop at same effort: clear_rudder) and radio course changes (set_race_distance).

arguments.reason: 2 km to go: build to about 168 s/500 if reserve allows

text: no cue: paddler is holding the 171 pace target at about 150 W with 44 pct reserve; updated the plan for the build at 2 km and the sprint.

arguments.text: Feels like weed. One back-stroke to clear the rudder, then settle.

35.7 min (3.75 km left): push_local stepped from about -0.02 to -0.11 within 20 s at race_s 2012-2034, mid leg 5, then pod rose 148 to 162 W as the paddler chased the 171 pace and still lost speed (2.92 to 2.86). Step change mid-leg suggests weed on the rudder. Cued clear_rudder. Check after: speed should recover at the same power and push_local return to about 0 (leg 6 had about -0.05 last time). If not, it was wind, not weed.

arguments.reason: check whether clearing the rudder restored speed (push_local back near -0.05)

text: Cued clear_rudder: sudden mid-leg step down in speed for the pod power looks like weed on the rudder.
no cue: the drag alert is the back-stroke dip plus the turn just made; the pending check at 37.3 min will show whether clearing worked.

arguments.text: Rudder is clear. Back to two fifty pace, hold it steady.

37.3 min: after the back-stroke push_local is back to -0.06 on leg 6 (same as leg 4), so the weed was probably cleared. Pod reserve 36 pct, sustainable 156 W. Cued hold at 170 s/500. If push_local steps down again mid-leg (more than 0.08 in 20 s), clear again.

arguments.name: push_step
arguments.source:
w = window("push_local_mps", 60)
w[-1] - mean(w[:20]) if len(w) >= 40 else 0.0
arguments.description: push_local now minus its mean 40-60 s ago (a sudden drop means extra drag such as weed)

arguments.condition: push_step < -0.09 and next_turn_in_m > 60 and next_turn_in_m < 1050 and remaining_m > 150
arguments.message: Sudden mid-leg drop in speed for the pod power (push_local step): weed again? Consider clear_rudder.

text: Rudder clear (push back to normal); cued hold at 170 s/500 with 36 pct reserve, and added a watch for another sudden mid-leg drag step.
no cue: pod effort steady at about 156 W (the sustainable level), leg 6 matches leg 4 once the back-stroke dip is excluded, small fatigue fade only; build planned at 2 km.

arguments.text: Two and a half k left. Lift to two fifty-four.

43.3 min, 2.47 km left, leg 7 just started: paddler dipped on their own to 130-137 W for about 1.5 min at 41-42 min (GPS 2.7), then back to 154 W; pod reserve 40 pct, sustainable 158 W. Speed fade at the same rate -4 to -9 pct (tiring). Cued push to 174 s/500 (about 158 W; 169 would empty the reserve in 4 min). Finish sprint at about 650 m to go.

text: Cued push to 174 s/500: 40 pct pod reserve allows about 158 W to the finish sprint at about 650 m.

arguments.text: Two k to go. Push to two fifty-two now.

46.0 min, 2.0 km left: paddler at 150 W pod, GPS 2.85 (175 pace), pod reserve 43 pct and rising (below CP), sustainable 160 W: reserve going unused. Cued push to 172 s/500 (about 159 W, spends about 4 kJ by 700 m to go). Then finish cue at about 650-700 m.

arguments.reason: check the 172 push took (last push at 43.3 min did not raise power)

text: Cued push to 172 s/500 at 2 km to go: 43 pct pod reserve unused and rising; checking in 90 s that it took.

arguments.text: Breathe, recover. You are fine, we bring it home together.

arguments.reason: Paddler blew up twice (41 min and 47.5 min, pod down to 125-130 W, says 10/10 I am gone) after holding 150-158 W pod; my earlier raise to 153 W was too generous. Boat-model power at those blow-ups was about 88-90 W (blade efficiency has faded).

arguments.text: Final 1.7 km. Paddler blew up at 47.5 min (10/10, I am gone, pod 125 W) after a push cue, and dipped earlier at 41 min: they are at their limit, push cues are not followed or tip them over. Critical power reset at 47.7 min to 147 W pod / 88 W boat. Let them recover (reassure, no push) for a minute or two; then hold about 175-178 s/500 GPS. Cue finish (sprint) late, at about 400-450 m to go, only if pod power is back near 145 W; if still blown, cue finish at about 250-300 m. No more mid-race pushes. Weed: clear only on a clear mid-leg drag step.

arguments.reason: finish sprint decision (plan: cue finish at about 400-450 m if recovered)

arguments.text: 47.7 min, 1.72 km left: BLOW-UP. Paddler 10/10 I am gone, pod 125 W, GPS 2.69, right after my push cue at 46.1 min (power went to 158 then collapsed). Cued reassure. Reset CP to 147 W pod / 88 W boat: pod reserve now 10 pct, boat 22 pct. Ignore the 750 m wake (too early for a sprint); finish decision at 450 m.

text: Paddler blew up (10/10, pod 125 W): cued reassure, reset critical power to 147 W pod / 88 W boat, and moved the finish sprint to about 400-450 m.
no cue: paddler recovered to 151 W pod on the last leg, holding steady; finish sprint call due at about 450 m.
no cue: 750 m is too early for a sprint with 15 pct pod reserve after the blow-up; finish call at about 450 m.

arguments.text: Four fifty to go. Sprint now, everything to the line!
